title: A Cipher for the Portrait
author: Astrid Sterling
blurb: Jude Dunmore, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
